authorization_basis: Adopted GOAL.json controller.new_segment_allocation; explicit incremental allocation with cumulative costs and unchanged scientific criteria

predecessor.rule: Retain all previous authorities, failures, receipts, logs, binaries and counters. Pin current candidate source hashes in this segment RUN_BINDING before edits.

allowed_paths.generated: Previously authorized task target/ and deterministic test data outputs

invalid_rhs_cases.base: Use one valid mixed gas state at T=10000 K with nh=1e-4 and nhe=.08*nh. Compare canonical and candidate error variant/message.
single_faults: positive heat with corresponding gamma zero
forged hydrogen fraction greater than one
invalid_rhs_cases.combined_fault: Negative expansion rate together with zero CMB temperature, preserving original error precedence
invalid_rhs_cases.rule: Each fixture must actually invoke both evaluators. Constructor rejection followed by continue is not an RHS error-parity test. Preserve raw case IDs and returned errors.

shared_rhs_gate.change: Extract existing all-field comparison and gross_and_conservation checks into reusable validation helper. Keep every existing formula and bound unchanged.
shared_rhs_gate.use: Call from both 257-temperature validation matrix and benchmark pretiming checks.
shared_rhs_gate.scope: Compare all 45 RHS fields, finite values and original nuclei/charge/energy checks. Retain separate rate-bundle and diagnostic checks.
shared_rhs_gate.remove: Replace main.rs temperature_dt-only net-relative pretiming check with shared frozen gate; do not retain extra stricter cancellation-sensitive gate.

benchmark_inputs.temperatures: Use 64 interior members of existing 257-temperature grid: indices 4*j-2 for j=1..64, with T=temperature(index*N/256).
benchmark_inputs.other_inputs: Use same mixed fractions, nh, nhe expression, h, Tcmb and gamma-derived heat as corresponding validation fixture. Prefer shared fixture constructor so actual binary64 inputs agree.
benchmark_inputs.pretiming: Validate each actual reference/candidate timed pair with shared all-field gate before timing.
benchmark_inputs.comparison: Reference and candidate retain identical input order, counts, duplicate rate-evaluation count and output consumption.

guard_adjacent_slopes.change: Include endpoint-node temperatures of each guarded cell in candidate slope list, deduplicated.
guard_adjacent_slopes.eligibility: Apply existing centered stencil and requirement entire stencil lie in one smooth unguarded branch.
guard_adjacent_slopes.record: Record compared and skipped counts with guarded-stencil reasons. Added endpoint stencils may all be ineligible; no one-sided derivatives or relaxed exclusion.

accounting.rule: Reserve against segment and original cumulative ceilings before execution. Carry prior counts 360926/295329 and all wall/CPU/output costs. Record epoch-local and cumulative counts separately. Preserve old local_test_counts.json; write new cumulative counts under gate_completion_001 and have successor benchmark read it. Include all constructor, invalid-input, reference, internal, fallback and lookup calls without double-counting.

execution.evidence: Record exact argv, cwd, before/after source hashes, stdout/stderr/exit, per-gate counts, cumulative costs, table hash and normal executable hash.
execution.repeated_matrix_reason: Comparison helper and coverage changed; one invocation of original matrix plus missing cases verifies validator. No completed physical history repeated.

stopping_and_transition.on_failure: Stop immediately on compile, numerical, invariant, accounting or resource failure. Preserve exact failing case/field and raw evidence. No fifth Cargo, automatic retry, additional repair or tolerance change authorized.
stopping_and_transition.on_local_pass: Read-only review only bounded diff and missing-gate evidence. If PASS, immediately consume original unused single NCP component launch under existing 299-second, one-thread and cumulative limits.
stopping_and_transition.on_ncp_failure: Preserve charged launch and exact failure; no second launch.
stopping_and_transition.claim_ceiling: Component table accuracy and same-host component timing only. Production integration, trajectory accuracy and whole-driver speedup NOT_ADMITTED/NOT_MEASURED.
stopping_and_transition.minimal_falsifier: Any invalid fixture differing error; any timed RHS pair fails one frozen field/conservation bound; or applicable slope sample fails existing bound.
